items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: realistic rehabilitation assessment step photograph, 004 E-GEN-004, s01 preparation.
Input images: images 1,2,3 are identity, clothing, lighting and gray-blue studio reference photographs of THE SAME adult East Asian woman. Preserve this exact woman's face, age, build, natural skin and black low ponytail. Do not copy their arm poses.
Primary request: One single photo, first of a four-frame forward lunge sequence. Show quiet standing BEFORE stepping forward. Full body in side view, looking and facing to the RIGHT; camera nearly perpendicular to walking direction, slight 10-degree front offset to separate the two shoes and show support-hand contact. Both knees straight but unlocked, both feet flat, alongside each other at hip width at the starting location, no stride yet, torso upright. Her LEFT hand lightly rests on a stable waist-height gray metal handrail at her left side, a little forward of her hip; other arm relaxed naturally. Keep hand and rail contact believable and visible.
Scene/backdrop: exact cool light gray-blue studio backdrop and matching seamless floor from references, soft cloudy tonal variation. Simple long fixed gray metal rail with two floor-bolted vertical posts, running parallel to the future stepping direction on the woman's left side, posts outside the leg area. Only ONE short charcoal-gray flat transverse floor tape strip is the forward foot landing target, about 55–65 cm ahead of the starting toes. Rail and landing strip both completely in frame. No weights.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536 by 1024, one camera, full head and both hands and full shoes visible with ample floor space. Subject just left of center, extra clear space to the right for the future forward foot and tape strip. Show realistic rail geometry, floor contact shadows, normal adult body proportions, no stretched torso or short legs. Full-body side profile with clear hip, knee and ankle landmarks.
Outfit: same plain white short-sleeve crew-neck fitted t-shirt and dark charcoal straight trousers as reference, white simple low-top flat sneakers.
Lighting: soft studio photo lighting and natural skin and fabric texture exactly like references.
Constraints: ONE woman, ONE pose, ONE photograph. A preparation standing pose with no walking, no bent-knee lunge yet. No text, numbers, arrows, labels, watermark or montage. No gym, no extra people, no extra equipment. Anatomically continuous joints, realistic five-finger hands and two shoes.

QA.observations: 同一女性、服装及灰蓝棚拍柔光；双足平放准备，前方单一近距离落点贴条、固定扶栏与手接触可见；侧面全身及完整双鞋，无额外负重。

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the photo to edit. Correct ONLY its single floor tape target position.
Keep the exact woman, her face, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, white sneakers, her quiet two-feet-flat ready stance, both hands, handrail contact, the entire gray metal railing and bolted posts, gray-blue backdrop, soft light, 1536x1024 landscape composition, and camera absolutely unchanged.
The single charcoal floor tape strip currently centered at approximately image pixel (1102,904) is too far forward for a short comfortable forward step. REMOVE that strip from its old location and put the SAME one short flat strip centered at approximately (865,904), on the same floor depth line and the same transverse orientation, size and dark-gray shade. It should be around 55–65 cm forward from her starting toes. Exactly ONE target strip remains. Smooth matching floor texture at its old position. Nothing else changes. No text, number, arrow, watermark or extra line.

rejected_attempts.reason: 准备图前方贴条过远，缩短至近距离落点后采用。

LOCK the camera, entire 1536x1024 landscape framing, gray-blue seamless backdrop/floor, studio light, rail horizontal bar and both bolted posts, and the ONE target strip at its exact image-1 position. Her SAME far-side hand continues visibly resting on the same fixed rail, sliding a small distance along the bar only as naturally required by the new stance; same elbow gently bent. Near-side arm still relaxed at her side. No reaching both hands, no grip swap.

No changes to floor tape position or rail; no added objects. No text, arrows, numbers, watermark, motion blur, ghost figure, collage or panels.

items.correction_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve scientific-educational photo.
Edit IMAGE 1, the upright split stance. Keep the camera and scene locked. Create the DOWNWARD phase of this very SAME short forward lunge, by bending her two knees and lowering her pelvis by only about 15–20 cm. A SHALLOW controlled descent, not a deep lunge.
ABSOLUTE FOOT-PLACEMENT LOCK: KEEP BOTH SHOE LOCATIONS EXACTLY AS THEY ARE IN IMAGE 1. Do not slide the back foot even one shoe-length back. FRONT SHOE remains on the single tape strip at x700–830,y830–895. REAR SHOE remains at x455–600,y840–905, toe end around x590,y890. Keep rear toe planted there, NOT at x440 or x490. It is fine to keep the rear heel grounded for this shallow demonstration. Preserve the original short split stance; only bend knees. The rear knee bends but stays far above the floor. No kneeling.
Natural anatomy: moderate hip and knee flexion, upright torso, head/shoulders/hips clearly a little lower than upright frame, front knee around 40–55 degrees flexion. Same front/back anatomical legs as input, continuous natural thigh/shin proportions. Feet not crossed.
Her same far-side supporting hand maintains natural contact with this same fixed gray rail; other arm relaxed. Exact same woman face, white shirt, charcoal trousers, ponytail and white sneakers. Exact same 1536x1024 landscape camera, gray-blue backdrop and floor, ONE target strip and entire rail and bolted posts at same coordinates. Full head, hands, knees and both shoes. One photographic pose, no arrows/text/montage/watermark.

rejected_attempts.reason: 下降初稿后脚移远，组内脚位不一致。

rejected_attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise pose correction.
Image 1 is the current descended lunge frame to correct. Image 2 is the preceding upright split stance that DEFINES the correct foot contact locations. Image 3 is initial scene/reference. Keep exact same camera, full 1536x1024 landscape framing, fixed gray metal rail and two bolted posts, tape target, woman identity/face/hair/outfit, studio light and gray-blue floor/backdrop.
CRITICAL correction: the REAR FOOT in image 1 has slid backward much too far. Restore its floor toe/forefoot contact to the SAME ground position as the REAR FOOT in image 2. In image 2, rear shoe occupies approximately x460–600 y840–905, with its forward/toe end at about x590,y890. The corrected image-1 REAR SHOE TOE must end near x590,y890, not x440,y870. The rear heel can lift naturally while the forefoot stays there. The FRONT SHOE stays precisely on the tape at x700–830,y830–895, exactly unchanged. Do NOT move tape. Do NOT move either rail post.
Adapt only the rear leg and, if anatomically necessary, slightly reduce the depth of the lower-body lunge to fit this original short split stance. Both knees stay visibly bent and hips lowered relative to image 2, a comfortable shallow controlled lunge is acceptable. Rear knee is suspended clearly ABOVE floor, never kneeling. Do not extend stride or slide any contact backward. Keep normal upper-leg and shin lengths; continuous realistic joints.
Preserve image 1 upper-body appearance, soft expression, torso naturally upright and supporting hand in contact with SAME rail; same relaxed near-side arm. Full woman and both complete shoes visible. One photo, no text, arrows, symbols, extra markers, watermark, montage or ghost poses.
rejected_attempts.reason: 定向修订后后脚仍有位移，未采用。
